question: In a classroom, there are six lectures of Maths, English, Hindi, Science, Physics and Chemistry which takes place in a week starting from Sunday to Saturday but not necessarily in the same order, only one lecture held on a particular day. Maths should be organised on Tuesday and should not be followed by English. English is organised on the day immediately before "no lecture day". Friday has Chemistry lecture. Physics should not be organised on Thursday. There is a gap of two days between English and Science. Chemistry should be organised immediately after Hindi. Which day is "No Lecture Day"?
